facts.fact: Wentor 情报：贸易线一周前被冲毁；两月前丢了一宗 wolframite 镖货、更早 Dranderon 盔甲被盗（已报 High General 无下文）；Ellis 提到曾警告过边境定居者撤离——「What the fuck?」她的震惊
facts.anchor: We lost a delivery of wolframite about two months ago

facts.fact: 归程谈心：他的背景补完（foot soldier↔Sea Guard 交替、「My family required it of me」）+领导力观察——「你的女性本质带来另一种觉察与权威」；「You put yourself in the pinch-points」；「Your empathy was the kind a mother would give」——她答「我没有母爱可对照」
facts.anchor: Part of your nature—being female—brings a different level of awareness.

facts.fact: 听觉的告白：全天噪音只有一件事能盖过——「自那天起你就是我的安静」；她回「And you are my calm, Draven」
facts.anchor: Since that day, you have been my quiet.

facts.fact: 夜营：Draven 挪到她身边睡、一只手抓住她的腰带不放——「抓不住你我无法真正放松警惕」；她「I'll allow it」+整夜看他多过看世界
facts.anchor: if I can’t hold onto you, I won’t be able to let my guard down

facts.fact: 卷轴内容：正面只有一行「Acting General, Commander Lavina Theron」+背面 Reynolds 签名——「That was all they wrote?」
换岗之痛：交班唤醒 Icarus 时她突然意识到——将来他的试炼她无法这样支持他——「transition hurts no matter how much I want this」
facts.anchor: The pain of the transition settles with a nauseating sadness.
